## Checklist
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added/updated; CI green
- [ ] No real photos, datasets, weights or `.env` files
- [ ] No health / lifespan / disease / fertility claims in rules, templates or prompts
- [ ] New rules cite their source (work + locator)
- [ ] Docs updated (ARCHITECTURE / DECISIONS) if a design decision changed
